scope: Read-only original executable inspection and bounded independent SH integer execution; no production changes or hardware acceptance.

inputs.title: Silver

layout.constructor_gap: Different exact address-register transport and a four-byte-longer 48-slot construction body; current constructor contract does not match.
layout.gun_wrapper_gap: The sparse gun body matches, but its encoded BSR targets completion_call minus 0x3a; current reviewed wrapper family requires minus 0x4a. A complete shorter-wrapper contract is needed.
layout.initializer_wrapper_gap: Older prefix reaches JSR at+40 with delay at+42; current family reaches JSR at+48 with delay at+50. Both share the first 28 bytes of save/mask setup. Older prefix calls a lock-preparation helper with BSR+28/NOP; it loads R7 capacity at+32, initializer R3 at+34 and transports TX/RX at+36/+38. Current prefix performs inline lock-cell/P2 loads before its helper. Prove the older helper lock-pointer alias publication and inherited SR behavior independently, then its upper/root call chain.

inputs.terminal_gap: Older mode-1 / cleanup-mode-2 pair has entries eight bytes apart. Current independent 12-byte veneers would overlap. A new complete interception contract is required; the ordinary three-vector/bootstrap family does not match.

allocator.shared_shape: Initializer aligns to 32 bytes, stores arena/cursor/sentinel, and tail-branches to release; allocate is initializer+0xae and release is initializer+0x160. There is no two-entry dispatch-table identity used by the current generic family.

allocator.limit: No assertion about the complete allocator implementation or its lifetime; requires separate discovery/provenance analysis.

recommendation.next_family: Time Stalkers direct-tail32 allocator, alternate uniform constructor and compact BIOS terminal pair
recommendation.reason: The same direct allocator appears in Silver and Soul Reaver, while Time Stalkers has a disjoint heap/image interval and a unique reviewed timer pair. This offers reusable family work after the smaller Grandia ambiguity fix.
requirements: Define explicit direct-allocator metadata/identity admission; do not fabricate dispatch cells.
Prove actual initializer and release gateway stack/register/PC-relative transport before patching.
Add an independently constrained alternate constructor and shorter completion-wrapper family.
Prove nonoverlapping compact-exit interception covering every encoded firmware consumer.
Retain live RX/TX, image, heap, DMA, physical-card and storage ownership checks.
recommendation.silver_extra: Two complete timer pairs and stored image/heap overlap require additional provenance/typed ownership proof. Do not select the nearby timer pair or trim image bytes by heuristic.
recommendation.hotd2_extra: Allocator remains unproved; alternate constructor and terminal shape alone cannot admit the game.

methods: Public kui_vmu_native_discover compiled from current source resolves all three drivers.
Existing call_expression evaluator applied only as a private read-only probe reconstructs the two older startup argument transports.
Existing tests/test_vmu_native_heap_execution.py SH model executes original initializer/allocate/release code; does not simulate the entire game.
Every halfword PC-relative long load is conservatively checked for the two currently watched firmware literals. Encoded consumers are not a proof of actual runtime reachability.

common_constructor_semantics.result: The same 48 contiguous 1 KiB slots as the current uniform layout, produced by a different exact address-register transport; not a new wire ABI.

related_direct_allocator_case.scope: Related existing corpus input, not one of the three newly inspected bundles; same direct-tail32 shape, still blocked by other layout/terminal and image-ownership requirements.
